g.text: UC06 is triggered by leaving the safe path.
It is a system response experienced by the Player.
Java cancels commands, clears memory and returns to Level.start().
UC02 replaces microphone/transcription with typed instructions.
Actor associations show participation, not message order.
UC03 context: "other way" uses held directions;
MovementIntent, including a new timer after expiry.
UC04 replaces an active instruction with its newer correction.
UC05 supports diagonal or bounded-duration movement.
Say Swear: shared game / agent / control core
One Java application, launched with either JavaFX or a CLI frontend. UC03-UC06 occur during UC01 or UC02.
The human selects every direction; no actor or use case delegates route planning to the model.
